00_hpo_tfm_custom_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Vaswani et al. (2017) + Orthogonal Attention Regularization (Thesis Proposal)
checked_mechanisms: Full multi-head self-attention with post-LayerNorm
Orthogonal attention regularization loss (lambda_ortho * ||A A^T - I||_F^2)
Clean 10-seed benchmarking with deterministic SEED protocol

01_hpo_tfm_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Vaswani et al. (NeurIPS 2017) - Attention Is All You Need
checked_mechanisms: Multi-head self-attention encoder layers (Vaswani et al., NeurIPS 2017)
Positional encoding
Canonical baseline purity: GaussianNoise completely purged from HPO and benchmark
Dual feature aggregation head (last step + global pooling)
Safe run_benchmark execution guard

02_hpo_dec_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Vaswani et al. (NeurIPS 2017) / Radford et al. - Autoregressive Causal Decoder
checked_mechanisms: Masked multi-head attention
deviations: Causal mask applied strictly across lookback history (L=96), crippling bidirectional history attention
Forecast horizon (H=48) is predicted simultaneously via generic 2-layer MLP head rather than autoregressive causal decoding

03_hpo_encdec_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Vaswani et al. (NeurIPS 2017) - Sequence to Sequence Cross-Attention
checked_mechanisms: Encoder self-attention and decoder cross-attention
deviations: Decoder queries are 48 repeated copies of last encoder step instead of zero/label initialized sequence
Forecast head flattens H * d_model into single dense layer creating 786K parameters in head_fc1 alone

04_hpo_ifm_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Zhou et al. (AAAI 2021) - Informer: Beyond Efficient Transformer for Long Sequence Time-Series Forecasting
checked_mechanisms: ProbSparse Attention mechanism with O(L log L) complexity
Distilling convolution layers with MaxPool1d
Triangular causal attention masking in generative decoder (Zhou et al., AAAI 2021)
Verified synthetic forward pass [2, 96, 28] -> [2, 48]
Safe run_benchmark execution guard with if __name__ == "__main__"

05_hpo_afm_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Wu et al. (NeurIPS 2021) - Autoformer: Decomposing Transformers with Auto-Correlation
checked_mechanisms: Moving average series decomposition with edge replicate padding
AutoCorrelation mechanism via Wiener-Khinchin FFT delay aggregation
Progressive trend accumulation across decoder layers
Token-wise linear projection heads (Linear(d_model, 1))

06_hpo_ptst_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Nie et al. (ICLR 2023) - A Time Series is Worth 64 Words: Long-term Forecasting with Transformers
checked_mechanisms: Sub-series temporal patching (patch_len=8, stride=4)
Channel Independence architecture
RevIN instance normalization with restored denorm step (Nie et al., ICLR 2023)
Safe run_benchmark execution guard

07_hpo_itfm_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Liu et al. (ICLR 2024) - iTransformer: Inverted Transformers Are Effective for Time Series Forecasting
checked_mechanisms: Inverted tokens: transposes time into token dimension and variates into sequence dimension
Variate-attention across all 28 feature channels
Target variate direct readout (out[:, TARGET_CH_IDX, :])
Token-wise Linear(d_model, horizon) projection head

checked_mechanisms: 1D-to-2D transformation via top-k FFT periodicities
TimesBlock with 2D Inception convolutions

Multi-layer nn.LSTM recurrence (Hochreiter & Schmidhuber, 1997)

11_hpo_dlinear_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Zeng et al. (AAAI 2023) - Are Transformers Effective for Time Series Forecasting?
checked_mechanisms: Moving average series decomposition
Separate linear models for seasonal and trend components
deviations: Artificially isolated to univariate target only, dropping all 27 external features (temperatures, calendar, lags); canonical Zeng et al. (AAAI 2023) supports multivariate inputs via Channel Independence, artificially doubling prediction error (MAE 6.983 kW)

12_hpo_nlinear_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Zeng et al. (AAAI 2023) - Are Transformers Effective for Time Series Forecasting?
checked_mechanisms: Subtraction of last lookback value
Single linear mapping + addition of last lookback value
deviations: Artificially isolated to univariate target only, dropping all 27 external features; canonical Zeng et al. (AAAI 2023) supports multivariate inputs via Channel Independence, artificially degrading baseline (MAE 6.247 kW)

13_hpo_smamba_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Wang et al. (2024); Gu & Dao (2023) - Is Mamba Effective for Time Series Forecasting?
checked_mechanisms: Selective State Space Model (SSM) bidirectional scan in pure PyTorch
deviations: Scans sequentially along time steps instead of inverted variate tokens as specified in S-Mamba paper (Wang et al., 2024)
Generic 2-layer MLP head with temporal average pooling instead of linear time-axis projection

14_hpo_powermamba_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Menati et al. (2024) - PowerMamba: Dual-Path Selective State Space Model for Power Systems
checked_mechanisms: Series decomposition into seasonal and trend
deviations: Fails to implement canonical PowerMamba (Menati et al., 2024): lacks dual-path iMamba (transposed variate scan), lacks concatenated [T; S] fixed embedding, lacks composite fusion head [x_e; x_m; x_im; x_m (x) x_im], and lacks RevIN; implemented as toy shortcut (SeriesDecomp + 1D SSM + Linear + MLP head)

15_hpo_timemachine_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Ahamed & Cheng (2024) - TimeMachine: A Time Series is Worth 4 Mambas for Long-term Forecasting
checked_mechanisms: Dual directional Mamba recurrence
deviations: Fails to implement canonical TimeMachine (Ahamed & Cheng, 2024): lacks 2-stage multi-scale embedding (n1 > n2), lacks quadruple-Mamba pyramid (2 fine + 2 coarse), lacks residual multi-scale projection head; implemented as single-scale ad-hoc sum of 2 time SSMs + 2 channel SSMs with MLP head

16_hpo_s4d_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Gu et al. (ICLR 2022) - Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces
checked_mechanisms: Diagonal state space transition matrix Lambda
Cauchy kernel evaluation via circular FFT convolution with 2L padding
GLU feedforward activation
deviations: Generic 2-layer MLP head with temporal average pooling instead of canonical sequence projection
